# Retained demo city navigation repair

The preview25 test-only dual-companion city preserves a real failed creation:
the route query returns points but the following companion cannot reach the
first projected navigation point across a wall. Coarse bake settings also admit
low architecture that the physical controller cannot traverse. Repeated Euler
rotation updates eventually accumulate scale error and fail the unchanged
upright-body restore validator.

`desktop/plan-city-companion-navigation-upgrade.mjs` is a read-only developer
repair planner for that recognized source. It matches the wrapper, city script,
runtime script and scene bytes before producing one source replacement. It does
not mutate released module archives, import templates, saved state or databases.
Apply its result through the existing history source CAS, check, preview and
adoption pipeline. Full source revision/manifest identities remain authoritative;
the recognized files are not a general compatibility certificate for other worlds.

The source-local wrapper retains companion identities, settings, interactions,
physics collision and state validation. Its navigation bake matches the map's
cell dimensions and physical slope/climb capabilities. If the nearest path entry
is obstructed or disconnected, it tests nearby projected entry points with the
actual body motion sweep and accepts only a route reaching the destination's
navigation projection. The companion walks to that entry with ordinary physics.
It waits when navigation is unavailable instead of using direct wall-pushing.
Heading is constructed as an upright unit rotation without iterative scale drift.

The planner does not claim arbitrary navigation, crowd avoidance or automatic
repair of other generated scripts. A path query or automatic build check alone
does not establish gameplay success. Actual movement, collision placement,
state preservation and a cold restart must pass before publishing a separate
corrected template. The original failing template and delivered ZIP stay immutable.
